2. Learned counsel for the petitioner has filed a supplementary affidavit in Court.
Let it be kept on record.
3. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 498A & 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
4. Petitioner, who is husband of opposite party no2., is said to have ousted the opposite party no.2 from her matrimonial home in association of his family members over the dowry demand.

5. By way of filing a supplementary affidavit, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.62116 of 2021(6)
dt.15-01-2024 learned counsel for the petitioner has brought on record the order dated 29.06.2022 passed by the learned Principal Judge, Family Court, Nalanda in Matrimonial (Divorce) Case No.92 of 2022, by which the joint divorce petition filed by the petitioner and opposite party no.2 was Md.
